    Projective-stable Hom spaces in a linear category #

    This file forms the scalar quotient of a Hom space by the maps which factor through categorical projectives. It records only the one-sided stable Hom spaces and their postcomposition maps needed by the finite-functor-category Auslander--Reiten argument.
